flags: minor: distractors weak; C and D are easily eliminated, A is the only plausible opposite
S031-01.notes: Reproduced 'exactly' -> faithful to its original. A contradicts; C unsupported; D illogical for a building.

flags: minor: 'only if' in the passage nearly defines 'conditional', making it a lookup
S031-02.notes: Takes effect only if a condition is met = conditional.

flags: minor: B is the only real trap ('proves' is too strong); A and C are easily eliminated
S031-03.notes: Alternative explanation (climate/food decline) coincides with human arrival, so timing alone does not establish human causation. B overclaims; A, C unsupported/contradicted.

S031-04.notes: Avoidance of an identical park with no trapping history implicates park features, not the trapping memory. B and D support the hypothesis; A is consistent with fading association.

flags: minor: A is the only choice comparing seasons across schedules, which some will spot quickly
S031-05.notes: Dry 96-75=21, rainy 97-93=4; arithmetic correct. B, C, D are true but do not compare the cleaning effect across seasons.

flags: minor: D closely paraphrases Text 2's key sentence ('recording what was thought to be known... more than a way of marking danger'), making it near-lookup
S031-06.notes: Historian holds creatures recorded believed knowledge rather than warnings. A agrees with Text 1; B and C unsupported.

flags: minor: key is the longest choice
S031-07.notes: Goal needs both an advantage and an explanation of what a qanat is for an unfamiliar audience. A gives advantage but no definition (trap); C and D give no advantage.

flags: minor: factual framing OK (2022 HTHH injected ~150 Tg water vapor, little SO2; early studies suggested possible warming, later analyses found net slight cooling), and 'some scientists suggest it might' is suitably hedged
S031-08.notes: Little SO2 (no cooling agent); instead it emitted water vapor. B, C, D illogical relations.

S031-09.notes: List items contain internal commas and later items are separated by semicolons, so 'Iceland;' is required for consistency.

S031-10.notes: Subject 'Sylvia Earle' needs a finite main verb after the interrupting clause; A, B, C leave no main verb.
